WITH resin_stock AS (
    SELECT
        'Inventory / Stock'::text AS source,
        'Stock position'::text AS record_type,
        s.item_code::text AS item_code,
        i.name::text AS item_name,
        CASE
            WHEN s.available_qty > 0 THEN 'Available'
            WHEN s.available_qty <= 0 THEN 'Out of stock'
            ELSE 'Unknown'
        END::text AS status,
        NULL::text AS reference,
        s.branch::text AS location_or_branch,
        NULL::text AS counterparty,
        NULL::date AS record_date,
        s.available_qty::numeric AS quantity,
        i.default_unit_of_measurement::text AS uom
    FROM stock s
    JOIN items i ON i.item_code = s.item_code
    WHERE i.name ~* '[[:<:]]resin(s)?[[:>:]]'
), resin_requisitions AS (
    SELECT
        'Procurement'::text AS source,
        'Store requisition'::text AS record_type,
        r.item_code::text AS item_code,
        i.name::text AS item_name,
        r.status::text AS status,
        r.ref_no::text AS reference,
        r.branch::text AS location_or_branch,
        r.previous_supplier::text AS counterparty,
        r.prepare_date AS record_date,
        r.req_quantity::numeric AS quantity,
        i.default_unit_of_measurement::text AS uom
    FROM store_requisition r
    JOIN items i ON i.item_code = r.item_code
    WHERE i.name ~* '[[:<:]]resin(s)?[[:>:]]'
), resin_purchases AS (
    SELECT
        'Procurement'::text AS source,
        'Purchase record'::text AS record_type,
        p.item_code::text AS item_code,
        i.name::text AS item_name,
        'Purchased'::text AS status,
        COALESCE(p.po_number, p.ref_no)::text AS reference,
        p.branch::text AS location_or_branch,
        p.supplier::text AS counterparty,
        p.purchase AS record_date,
        p.qty::numeric AS quantity,
        i.default_unit_of_measurement::text AS uom
    FROM purchases_data p
    JOIN items i ON i.item_code = p.item_code
    WHERE i.name ~* '[[:<:]]resin(s)?[[:>:]]'
), resin_imports AS (
    SELECT
        'Shipments'::text AS source,
        'Import consignment'::text AS record_type,
        ci.item_code::text AS item_code,
        ci.item_name::text AS item_name,
        c.current_status::text AS status,
        c.instrument_number::text AS reference,
        br.name::text AS location_or_branch,
        sp.name::text AS counterparty,
        COALESCE(c.effective_date, c.eta, c.etd) AS record_date,
        ci.quantity::numeric AS quantity,
        ci.unit_of_measurement::text AS uom
    FROM consignments c
    JOIN consignment_items ci
      ON ci.consignment_id = c.id
     AND ci.is_deleted = false
    LEFT JOIN branches br ON br.id = c.branch_id
    LEFT JOIN suppliers sp ON sp.id = c.supplier_id
    WHERE c.is_deleted = false
      AND ci.item_name ~* '[[:<:]]resin(s)?[[:>:]]'
), resin_exports AS (
    SELECT
        'Shipments'::text AS source,
        'Export/local order'::text AS record_type,
        NULL::text AS item_code,
        li.item_detail::text AS item_name,
        lc.current_status::text AS status,
        lc.mo_no::text AS reference,
        lc.department::text AS location_or_branch,
        lc.customer_name::text AS counterparty,
        COALESCE(lc.effective_date, lc.actual_arrival_date, lc.etd_sailing_date) AS record_date,
        li.quantity::numeric AS quantity,
        NULL::text AS uom
    FROM logistics_consignments lc
    JOIN logistics_items li
      ON li.consignment_id = lc.id
     AND li.is_deleted = false
    WHERE lc.is_deleted = false
      AND li.item_detail ~* '[[:<:]]resin(s)?[[:>:]]'
), resin_trucking AS (
    SELECT
        'Shipments'::text AS source,
        'Road movement'::text AS record_type,
        NULL::text AS item_code,
        tc.item_details::text AS item_name,
        CASE
            WHEN EXISTS (
                SELECT 1
                FROM trucking_vehicles tv
                WHERE tv.consignment_id = tc.id
                  AND tv.is_deleted = false
                  AND tv.tracking_status <> 'Delivered'
            ) THEN 'In transit'
            WHEN EXISTS (
                SELECT 1
                FROM trucking_vehicles tv
                WHERE tv.consignment_id = tc.id
                  AND tv.is_deleted = false
            ) THEN 'Delivered'
            ELSE NULL
        END::text AS status,
        tc.reference_no::text AS reference,
        tc.destination::text AS location_or_branch,
        tc.transporter_name::text AS counterparty,
        tc.execution_date AS record_date,
        NULL::numeric AS quantity,
        NULL::text AS uom
    FROM trucking_consignments tc
    WHERE tc.is_deleted = false
      AND tc.item_details ~* '[[:<:]]resin(s)?[[:>:]]'
)
SELECT source, record_type, item_code, item_name, status, reference,
       location_or_branch, counterparty, record_date, quantity, uom
FROM resin_stock
UNION ALL
SELECT source, record_type, item_code, item_name, status, reference,
       location_or_branch, counterparty, record_date, quantity, uom
FROM resin_requisitions
UNION ALL
SELECT source, record_type, item_code, item_name, status, reference,
       location_or_branch, counterparty, record_date, quantity, uom
FROM resin_purchases
UNION ALL
SELECT source, record_type, item_code, item_name, status, reference,
       location_or_branch, counterparty, record_date, quantity, uom
FROM resin_imports
UNION ALL
SELECT source, record_type, item_code, item_name, status, reference,
       location_or_branch, counterparty, record_date, quantity, uom
FROM resin_exports
UNION ALL
SELECT source, record_type, item_code, item_name, status, reference,
       location_or_branch, counterparty, record_date, quantity, uom
FROM resin_trucking
ORDER BY source, record_type, record_date NULLS LAST, reference NULLS LAST, item_code NULLS LAST

        s.available_qty AS quantity,
        COALESCE(i.default_unit_of_measurement, ri.default_unit_of_measurement) AS uom,
        NULL::text AS reference
    FROM stock s

     AND li.is_deleted = false
    WHERE lc.is_deleted = false

question: which supplier has the most delayed purchase orders
normalised: which supplier most delayed purchase orders
sql:
WITH supplier_delays AS (
    SELECT
        lower(trim(p.supplier)) AS supplier_key,
        min(trim(p.supplier)) AS supplier,
        COUNT(DISTINCT p.po_number) AS delayed_purchase_orders
    FROM purchases_data p
    WHERE p.supplier IS NOT NULL
      AND trim(p.supplier) <> ''
      AND p.po_number IS NOT NULL
      AND trim(p.po_number) <> ''
      AND p.purchase IS NOT NULL
      AND p.required_d IS NOT NULL
      AND p.purchase > p.required_d
    GROUP BY lower(trim(p.supplier))
), ranked_suppliers AS (
    SELECT
        sd.supplier,
        sd.delayed_purchase_orders,
        RANK() OVER (ORDER BY sd.delayed_purchase_orders DESC) AS supplier_rank
    FROM supplier_delays sd
)
SELECT
    rs.supplier,
    rs.delayed_purchase_orders
FROM ranked_suppliers rs
WHERE rs.supplier_rank = 1
ORDER BY rs.supplier

question: Which purchase orders are delayed?
sql:
SELECT p.po_number, MAX(p.po_date) AS po_date, COUNT(*) AS delayed_line_count, MIN(p.required_d) AS earliest_required_date, MAX(p.purchase) AS latest_purchase_date, MAX(p.purchase - p.required_d) AS max_delay_days
FROM purchases_data p
WHERE p.po_number IS NOT NULL
  AND btrim(p.po_number) <> ''
  AND p.required_d IS NOT NULL
  AND p.purchase IS NOT NULL
  AND p.purchase > p.required_d
  AND p.purchase >= date_trunc('month', CURRENT_DATE) - INTERVAL '12 months'
  AND p.purchase < date_trunc('month', CURRENT_DATE)
GROUP BY p.po_number
ORDER BY max_delay_days DESC, p.po_number

question: Shipment/transit status
sql:
WITH import_shipments AS (
    SELECT
        v.consignment_id AS shipment_id,
        'Import'::text AS direction,
        v.item_name AS matched_item,
        v.shaft_type AS shaft_type,
        v.current_status AS shipment_status,
        v.supplier AS counterparty,
        v.eta AS expected_arrival,
        v.etd AS departure_date,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY v.consignment_id ORDER BY v.id) AS row_num
    FROM v_import_shafts v
), export_shipments AS (
    SELECT
        lc.id AS shipment_id,
        'Export'::text AS direction,
        li.item_detail AS matched_item,
        NULL::text AS shaft_type,
        lc.current_status AS shipment_status,
        lc.customer_name AS counterparty,
        lc.actual_arrival_date AS expected_arrival,
        lc.etd_sailing_date AS departure_date,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY lc.id ORDER BY li.id) AS row_num
    FROM logistics_consignments lc
    JOIN logistics_items li
      ON li.consignment_id = lc.id
     AND li.is_deleted = false
    WHERE lc.is_deleted = false
      AND li.item_detail ~* '[[:<:]]shafts?[[:>:]]'
), road_shipments AS (
    SELECT
        tc.id AS shipment_id,
        'Road'::text AS direction,
        tc.item_details AS matched_item,
        NULL::text AS shaft_type,
        CASE
            WHEN EXISTS (
                SELECT 1
                FROM trucking_vehicles tv2
                WHERE tv2.consignment_id = tc.id
                  AND tv2.is_deleted = false
                  AND tv2.tracking_status <> 'Delivered'
            ) THEN 'Going to load'
            ELSE 'Delivered'
        END AS shipment_status,
        tc.transporter_name AS counterparty,
        tc.eta_works AS expected_arrival,
        tc.execution_date AS departure_date,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY tc.id ORDER BY tc.id) AS row_num
    FROM trucking_consignments tc
    WHERE tc.is_deleted = false
      AND tc.item_details ~* '[[:<:]]shafts?[[:>:]]'
      AND EXISTS (
          SELECT 1
          FROM trucking_vehicles tv
          WHERE tv.consignment_id = tc.id
            AND tv.is_deleted = false
      )
)
SELECT
    x.direction,
    x.matched_item,
    x.shaft_type,
    x.shipment_status,
    x.counterparty,
    x.expected_arrival,
    x.departure_date
FROM (
    SELECT direction, matched_item, shaft_type, shipment_status, counterparty, expected_arrival, departure_date, row_num
    FROM import_shipments
    WHERE row_num = 1
    UNION ALL
    SELECT direction, matched_item, shaft_type, shipment_status, counterparty, expected_arrival, departure_date, row_num
    FROM export_shipments
    WHERE row_num = 1
    UNION ALL
    SELECT direction, matched_item, shaft_type, shipment_status, counterparty, expected_arrival, departure_date, row_num
    FROM road_shipments
    WHERE row_num = 1
) x
ORDER BY x.direction, x.shipment_status, x.departure_date NULLS LAST
